_comment: Display upload guards. Firmware written to the wrong screen is the failure these prevent. Step 25 moved the watcher map and the listen pass to discovery/watcher.py and discovery/listen.py, so the last three mutations carry a per-mutation 'file' - each of those two files has its own copy of the same 'no port' / 'lower the id' guard, and a mutation only ever touches one file.

mutations.name: an upload without a port is refused
the upload command pins the port
a non-zero exit is a failure, not a success
a udev symlink is resolved to the device pio can see
the stable name stays the reported identity, not the resolved one
waiting-for-a-new-port is explained, not left as exit 2
a map version we do not understand is ignored
